description: This file defines an abstract exception class used for handling startup issues with required modules in the OpenMRS platform. It extends RuntimeException and is used when mandatory modules fail to start properly.

classes.name: ModuleMustStartException
classes.description: An abstract exception class indicating that certain modules must start during the OpenMRS initialization process.

methods.name: ModuleMustStartException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific message.
